async def act(page):
    """
    1) Attempt to dismiss any visible overlay/popup by clicking a close-like button (role="button")
       or pressing Escape as a fallback.
    2) After the UI settles, call the knowledge-base helper monitor_keyword_and_notify to scan
       the homepage for the exact article title '40 Of Our Most Helpful AI Tips From 2025'.
    3) Print and return the helper's raw result (no post-processing) as required.

    Notes:
    - monitor_keyword_and_notify is the appropriate KB helper for scanning the homepage
      for an article title; it will navigate to '/' as its first action and perform an
      accessibility-role-centric scan for articles. Per the instructions, we use the
      KB helper when available.
    - We dismiss the overlay first because KB helpers do not dismiss modals/overlays and
      a blocking popup could prevent the helper from seeing page content.
    """
    import asyncio

    article_title = "40 Of Our Most Helpful AI Tips From 2025"

    # 1) Try to dismiss visible overlay by clicking a close-like button
    try:
        buttons = page.get_by_role("button")
        try:
            btn_count = await buttons.count()
        except Exception:
            btn_count = 0

        closed = False
        for i in range(btn_count):
            try:
                btn = buttons.nth(i)
                # Guarded attribute and text reads
                try:
                    aria = (await btn.get_attribute("aria-label")) or ""
                except Exception:
                    aria = ""
                try:
                    text = (await btn.inner_text()) or ""
                except Exception:
                    text = ""
                name = (aria or text or "").strip()
                lower = name.lower()
                # Recognize common close tokens/glyphs
                if (
                    "close" in lower
                    or "dismiss" in lower
                    or "×" in name
                    or "✕" in name
                    or "✖" in name
                    or name == "x"
                ):
                    try:
                        await btn.click()
                        closed = True
                        break
                    except Exception:
                        # If click fails on this candidate, continue to next
                        continue
            except Exception:
                # If reading this button fails, continue
                continue

        if not closed:
            # Fallback: press Escape to dismiss common overlays
            try:
                await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Allow UI to settle
        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
    except Exception:
        # If anything fails while attempting to dismiss overlay, continue to helper call
        pass

    # 2) Use the KB helper to scan the homepage for the requested article title.
    # monitor_keyword_and_notify will navigate to '/' as its first action.
    try:
        results = await monitor_keyword_and_notify(
            page,
            article_title,
            check_interval_minutes=60,
            notify_via="none",
            max_results=20,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        # If the helper itself errors, surface the exception by re-raising so the runner sees it
        raise

    # 3) Print and return the raw results exactly as received (no transformation)
    print(results)
    return results
